title: The Bundle on the Doorstep
synopsis: A basket. A baby. A note: 'I trust you.' You don't know who 'I' is.

nodes.text: She is sleeping. A tiny hat. No tags.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
You commit to “Call police.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You don't own a crib. The laundry basket has just been emptied.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Practical.
You commit to “Drive to the 24-hour store.” The story records the instinct as “Forward” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Handwritten. 'I trust you. I'll come back. Be kind.'

choices.consequence: You commit to “Believe it.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: She fusses, then sleeps, then fusses. You learn fast.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stay calm” back. Care shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Cry quietly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: A woman, exhausted, at the door at sunrise. She is, you understand instantly, the mother.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Welcome her in” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Stand at the door.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: She drinks two cups. She tells you, slowly, the year she has had.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
You commit to “Offer help.” The story records the instinct as “Care” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You become an aunt-figure to the baby. You help out for a year. The mother gets back on her feet.
You don't tell most people. The week is yours. The baby grows up. You keep a small photo in a drawer.
